config.escalation.title: Advanced Difficulty Settings
config.escalation.category.presets.toolt: Picking a preset writes its values into every setting on the other tabs. Change any of those afterwards and the preset becomes Custom — there is no hidden layer, what the config file says is what runs.
config.escalation.preset.tooltip: Selecting a preset stamps every setting it governs. Editing one of those afterwards switches this to Custom.
config.escalation.scoreAdvancements.tool: Measure progress by completed advancements. Recipe unlocks don't count. Works with no other mods installed.
config.escalation.scoreArchetypes.toolti: Measure progress by your Archetypes level. Ignored entirely — not counted as zero — when Archetypes isn't installed.
config.escalation.scoreSkillProficiencie: Measure progress by your total skill levels. Ignored entirely — not counted as zero — when Skill Proficiencies isn't installed.
config.escalation.combineMode.tooltip: How the sources that can answer are folded into one score. Only sources that answered are combined.
config.escalation.advancementTarget.tool: Completed advancements that count as fully progressed.
config.escalation.skillTotalTarget.toolt: Total Skill Proficiencies levels that count as fully progressed. Their ceiling is 1500 (15 skills at 100).
config.escalation.spawnRateProgressionBo: Extra spawn rate at full progression
Adds this fraction to the spawn frequency as progression rises. 0 keeps spawn rate independent of progress.
config.escalation.elitePlate.tooltip: Show the elite's name, health and affixes at the top of the screen while your crosshair is on it. Display only — this setting is yours, not the server's, and no preset changes it.
config.escalation.eliteChanceMax.tooltip: Share of natural monster spawns that become elites once you're fully progressed. Starts near 1% in a fresh world and ramps late.
config.escalation.maxRarityTier.tooltip: 1 Uncommon, 2 Rare, 3 Epic, 4 Legendary. Locking a rarity raises the ones below it rather than producing fewer elites. Loot follows rarity.
config.escalation.legendaryWeightFloor.t: Minimum draw weight for Legendary regardless of progression. 0 leaves it on the normal curve, where it's genuinely absent early.
config.escalation.bonusAffixBudget.toolt: Extra affix points on top of each rarity's budget. The exclusion rules and both hard guarantees still apply.
config.escalation.bonusAffixSlots.toolti: Extra affix slots on top of each rarity's slot count.
config.escalation.bonusFromRarityTier.to: Lowest rarity the two bonuses above apply to. 1 Uncommon, 4 Legendary.
config.escalation.allowedAffixClasses.to: Leave empty to allow all. Otherwise a whitelist of: OFFENSE, DEFENSE, CONTROL, MOBILITY, AURA, SUPPORT, UTILITY, DEATH.
config.escalation.daySpawning.tooltip: Opens the light gate for hostile spawning. Surface monsters still need open sky, so a lit base stays safe.
config.escalation.daySpawnBurnImmunity.t: Stops sunlight burning while daylight spawning is on. Without it, day spawns die within seconds and the setting above does nothing.
config.escalation.spawnFrequencyMultipli: Natural spawn attempts per chunk, as a multiplier. 1.0 is exactly vanilla.
config.escalation.mobCapMultiplier.toolt: How many monsters the world will hold, as a multiplier. Affects both the world-wide and the per-chunk limit.
config.escalation.despawnDistanceMultipl: How far monsters follow you before despawning, as a multiplier. Below 1 they clear out sooner; above 1 they stick around.
config.escalation.theHunt.tooltip: Nearby monsters with nothing else to do come looking for you. They walk — nothing teleports, and terrain still works as cover.
config.escalation.category.general.toolt: Nothing here yet. Every knob lives on one of the tabs above.
commands.escalation.spawn.notAMob: %s is not a Mob — nothing to promote.
commands.escalation.preset.done: Preset %s applied — eliteChanceMax %s, maxRarityTier %s, daySpawning %s, theHunt %s
commands.escalation.audit.done: %s rolls at %s: %s violations, worst ehpIndex %s, mean affixes %s (ceiling %s)
